reference:
Card Printer — Markdown Format Reference
=========================================

Each card is a markdown block separated by --- (three dashes on their own line).

STRUCTURE PER CARD
------------------
# Card Title
**Type:** <type name> [optional #RRGGBB hex color]
**<Stat Name>:** <value>
**Copies:** <number>   (optional, default 1)

<blank line separates stats from body>
Body text here. Supports **bold**, *italic*, __underline__.
Multiple paragraphs are separated by blank lines.

BUILT-IN TYPES (auto-colored)
------------------------------
Spell   → purple      Feat    → green
Item    → orange      Ability → blue
Custom  → append a hex color, e.g.:  **Type:** Trap #8B0000

COPIES
------
**Copies:** 3  will print 3 instances of the card in the PDF.

EXAMPLE
-------
# Fireball
**Type:** Spell
**Level:** 3rd-level
**Range:** 150 feet
**Copies:** 2

A bright streak flashes from your finger to a point you choose,
then blossoms into a **20-foot-radius sphere** of flame.

---

# Lucky
**Type:** Feat

You have *inexplicable luck* that seems to kick in at just the right moment.

---

# Boss Goblin
**Type:** Boss #8B0000
**HP:** 42
**AC:** 15

A cunning goblin chieftain with __uncanny reflexes__.
